race.comment: Terrific race as always and plenty of win chances but sticking with the big run of OUR MISSILE (6) leading into this. Tackled the Newmarket in Cairns and after giving a big start charged home into third. Tricky gate this time but will be tough to stop late. The Healy yard has some good chances in the race including SHISUTA BO (4) who was a Darwin winner last time. Big chance to make it back-to-back successes. Stablemate HELLO WORLD (5) dropped back to 1000m last time and scored at Betoota and now jumps straight back to a mile. First try this trip but in form and can give a sight out front. GREEN SHADOWS (2) is fitter and looks a solid top-three chance. RAETIHI (8) is well weighted with the claim and looks one of the chances.
